notes.text:
Operator note for the next attempt (attempt 1 read from its transcript, 2026-08-29): the worker merged origin/main, hit a conflict in `.kanban/board.json` (main gained `{hook_settings}` inside the pinned launch arrays at 802ea81; this card removes those arrays), and from then on every tool call was refused — hkb's own PreToolUse hook throws when the worktree's board.json is not valid JSON (conflict markers), so the worker could not even edit the file. It looped on "Still blocked — no change." until its turn budget ran out. Bug filed as #184.

How to get past it this time: do the merge and the resolution in ONE command so there is no window in which board.json is invalid —
`git merge origin/main || (git checkout --ours .kanban/board.json && git add .kanban/board.json && git commit --no-edit)`
— and keep your version of board.json (no pinned `launch` on claude/claude-track, `"effort": "medium"` on both), which is exactly what main's `{hook_settings}` lines were a stopgap for. Verify with `node bin/hkb.js doctor` that `launch hooks` is ✓ afterwards (the default launch carries the placeholder). Everything else in attempt 1's worktree (README, harnesses.md, hook-install-shapes.md, log.md, the code) looked complete; the retry starts fresh, so redo it from the card.

Copilot CLI / Codex have no verified --effort flag so effort is left unset there rather than enforced by validation per-profile
verification: node bin/hkb.js doctor (launch hooks clean, no warning)

results.summary: effort is now a profile field ("low"|"medium"|"high"|"xhigh"), rendered into {model_args} alongside --model by a new pure modelArgs() helper (src/model.js), validated in loadBoard (src/board.js). No launch pin is needed just to set --effort any more. doctor's `launch hooks` fix on a stale pinned launch now names the surgical repair (insert {hook_settings} after --disallowedTools, or drop the pin only if it added nothing but --model/--effort) instead of a blanket 'drop launch'. Migrated this repo's own board.json: dropped the pinned launch arrays from claude/claude-track, set effort: medium on both; hkb doctor reports the launch hooks clean. Docs updated: README, docs/harnesses.md (profile shape, the doctor paragraph, an Actions known-edge row), and the hook-install-shapes wiki page. Copilot/Codex have no verified --effort equivalent (left unset, documented); the Actions worker workflow's claude_args is hand-written, not rendered from {model_args}, so effort has no effect there yet (documented, same gap as the existing per-task model override).
